notes.subject: tlhogo ya gago
notes.rationale: אף is literally nose/nostril — anger flares through the nostrils

notes.subject: וכיראתך
notes.rationale: 'according to your fear' — fear owed to you (JPS) or fear you impose; rendered as correspondence

notes.subject: go mameldiši
notes.rationale: rhetorical question draws the hearer to weigh the wrath of Yahwe

translation: Ke mang yo a tsebago maatla a tlhogo ya gago ya go hweletša? Gomme go swana le poifo ya gago, go hweletša ga gago.
